metadata.title: Clicked like a confused pigeon and somehow stole a kill? Valorant please explain!
metadata.description:
Me: no clue what just clicked
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-confusion
Valorant said ‘Here’s a kill, don’t ask why’
Click if your aim’s a mystery too!
